'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Afghanistan conflict (1978–present)|Afghanistan conflict]]
**[[Islamic State–Taliban conflict]]
***[[Taliban]] spokesperson [[Zabihullah Mujahid]] downplays the presence of [[ISIL]] in [[Afghanistan]], as analysts say that ISIL is using the same [[urban warfare]] tactics previously used by the Taliban to fight the [[Islamic Republic of Afghanistan|Western-backed Afghan government]]'s [[Afghan Armed Forces|forces]]. After the attack against [[Kabul airport]] last month, the Taliban has vowed to capture the leader of ISIL in Afghanistan. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/islamic-state-uses-talibans-own-tactics-attack-afghanistans-new-rulers-2021-09-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[Evergrande Default Crisis]]
**China's [[Real estate in China|largest property developer]] [[Evergrande]] misses the payment deadline of 83.5 million [[USD]] in [[Offshore investment|offshore]] [[bond (finance)|bonds]], increasing its chances of a [[bankruptcy]]. [https://www.ft.com/content/e7c0f31d-4dff-4992-88e6-a70402b7b4bc (Financial Times)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Laos]]
****[[Laos]] surpasses 20,000 cases of [[COVID-19]] after reporting a record 694 new cases in the past 24 hours. [https://laotiantimes.com/2021/09/23/covid-19-cases-reach-more-than-20000-in-laos-following-garment-factory-outbreaks/ (''The Laotian Times'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Nepal]], [[Travel restrictions related to the COVID-19 pandemic]]
****[[Nepal]] removes its [[quarantine]] requirement and resumes issuing [[travel visa|visas]] on arrival for foreign travellers that have been fully vaccinated against COVID-19. [https://www.laprensalatina.com/nepal-removes-quarantine-requirement-for-vaccinated-tourists/ (La Prensa Latina)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Singapore]]
****[[Singapore]] reports a record 1,504 new cases of COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 82,856. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/singapore/covid-19-sep-23-new-cases-record-number-2-deaths-2196891 (CNA)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Oceania]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Australia]]
****[[COVID-19 pandemic in Victoria]]
*****[[Victoria (Australia)|Victoria]] reports a record 766 new cases and four deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours. [https://www.abc.net.au/news/2021-09-23/victoria-records-new-local-covid-cases-vaccine-progress/100484718 (ABC News Australia)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Papua New Guinea]]
****[[Papua New Guinea]] announces a four-week lockdown in parts of the country including [[Eastern Highlands Province|Eastern Highlands]] as the number of COVID-19 cases continue to increase, primarily due to the [[Delta variant]]. Prime Minister [[James Marape]] had anticipated the move before leaving the country to attend the [[United Nations General Assembly]] this week in [[New York City]]. The country also struggles with its vaccination campaign, as only 2% of the population has been vaccinated. [https://www.rnz.co.nz/international/pacific-news/452111/png-to-announce-lockdown-in-several-provinces (RNZ)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Portugal]]
****[[Prime Minister of Portugal|Prime Minister]] [[António Costa]] announces that all remaining COVID-19-related restrictions will be lifted on October 1, allowing nightclubs to reopen and restaurants to operate without capacity limits as more than 80% of people have been fully vaccinated. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2021-09-23/portugal-to-lift-limits-at-restaurants-allow-nightclubs-to-open (Bloomberg)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Russia]]
****[[Russia]] reports 820 [[COVID-19 pandemic deaths|deaths]] in the past 24 hours, matching a single-day record set in late August, bringing the nationwide death toll to 201,445. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/liveblog_entry/russia-records-820-covid-deaths-in-past-day-matching-daily-high/ (''The Times of Israel'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Panama]]
***In a speech at the [[United Nations General Assembly]], [[President of Panama|President]] [[Laurentino Cortizo]] says that [[Panama]] is expected to reach [[herd immunity]] in the coming weeks after [[vaccination|vaccinating]] 4.2 million people. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/panama-approaching-herd-immunity-against-covid-19-president-says-2021-09-23/ (Reuters)]
*[[Foot-and-mouth disease]]
**[[Namibia]] reports the new strain of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) in the country that has infected thousands of [[cattle]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/namibia-detects-new-strain-foot-mouth-disease-2021-09-23/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Haiti–United States relations]], [[Haitian deportation in the United States]]
**[[United States Special Envoy for Haiti]] [[Daniel Lewis Foote]] resigns, citing his dissatisfaction with the [[Presidency of Joe Biden|Biden administration]]'s [[Immigration policy of the Joe Biden administration|policy]] of [[Haitian deportation in the United States|deporting illegal Haitian immigrants]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210923-us-envoy-to-haiti-resigns-slams-migrant-deportations (AFP via France 24)]
*[[Foreign relations of the Philippines]], [[Foreign relations of Palau]]
**[[Secretary of Foreign Affairs (Philippines)|Philippine foreign affairs secretary]] [[Teodoro Locsin Jr.]] meets with [[President of Palau|Palauan president]] [[Surangel Whipps Jr.]], with Locsin reiterating that the [[Philippines]] has a commitment to resolve a [[List of border disputes|maritime dispute]] with Palau regarding a 200 nautical mile [[exclusive economic zone]] which both countries currently claim. [https://www.philstar.com/headlines/2021/09/24/2129297/philippines-vows-resolve-maritime-dispute-palau (''Phil Star'')]
*[[France–United States relations]]
**[[French foreign minister]] [[Jean-Yves Le Drian]] tells [[U.S. Secretary of State]] [[Antony Blinken]] that it will take "time and actions" in order to restore confidence and good relations between [[France]] and the [[United States]] after France condemned the [[AUKUS|security pact]] between the United States, the [[United Kingdom]] and [[Australia]] announced last week. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/frances-le-drian-says-restoring-confidence-with-us-will-require-time-2021-09-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2017–2018 Spanish constitutional crisis]]
**Fugitive former [[President of the Generalitat of Catalonia|Catalan president]] [[Carles Puigdemont]] is arrested at an airport in [[Alghero]], [[Sardinia]], by the [[Italian police]] in compliance with a [[Search warrant|search]] and [[arrest warrant]] issued by the [[Supreme Court of Spain]]. He is accused of [[sedition]] for his role in the [[2017 Catalan independence referendum]] and the subsequent [[Declaration of Independence of Catalonia|failed declaration of independence]].  [https://cadenaser.com/ser/2021/09/23/tribunales/1632429898_279100.html (Cadena SER)]
*[[Collierville Kroger shooting]]
**A gunman [[mass shooting|opens fire]] at a [[Kroger]] [[supermarket]] in [[Collierville, Tennessee]], [[United States]], killing one person and injuring 12 others before [[murder–suicide|killing himself]]. [https://www.cnn.com/2021/09/23/us/tennessee-colliersville-shooting/index.html (CNN)]
*[[LGBT rights in Mexico]]
**[[Same-sex marriage]] is legalized in the state of [[Sonora]], [[Mexico]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/mexican-state-sonora-approves-same-sex-marriage-2021-09-24/ (Reuters)]
*[[Ukraine]] passes a law ordering [[Ukrainian oligarchs|oligarchs]] to stay [[Politics of Ukraine|out of politics]], a day after the failed [[assassination attempt]] to kill an aide of [[President of Ukraine|President]] [[Volodymyr Zelenskyi]], which officials said could have been a response to the reform. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/ukrainian-parliament-passes-law-oligarchs-final-reading-2021-09-23/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*The [[European Commission]] announces plans to require the [[USB-C]] connection to become the [[Computer port (hardware)|standard port]] for wired charging of all [[smartphone]]s, [[Tablet computer|tablets]], [[camera]]s, [[headphones]], [[Wireless speaker|portable speakers]] and [[Handheld game console|handheld video game consoles]]. [https://thehill.com/policy/technology/573569-eu-proposes-requirement-for-standard-charging-port-across-devices (The Hill)]
